paite: Huan, hichi ahia, leitungah mi a hongpung ua, tanute a honnei chiat ua.
english: It happened, when men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

paite: Pathian tapaten mite tanute mel hoih takin a mu ua; huchiin, a deihlam chiatte uh ji dingin a honnei jel uhi.
english: that God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took for themselves wives of all that they chose.

paite: Huchiin, Toupan, ka khain mi khantawnin a sual nilouh louh kei ding, amaute lah sa ahi ngal ua: ahihhangin kum ja leh kum sawmnih a dam ding uh, a chi a.
english: Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; yet will his days be one hundred twenty years.”

paite: Huai, lain miliante leiah a om ua; huai nungin leng Pathian tapaten mite tanute a kithuahpih ua, amau toh tate a neih jel laiun, huaite nidanglaia mihat, mi minthangte ahi uh.
english: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters. They bore children to them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

paite: Huan, Toupan, leiah mi gitlouhdan thupi ahi chih leh, a lungtang lunggeldan gilou ngen ahi ngitnget chih a na thei hi.
english: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

paite: Huchiin, leitunga mi a bawljiakin Toupa a kisika, lunggimnan a neih loh hi.
english: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

paite: Huchiin, Toupan, Ka mi siam leitung akipan ka hihmang mai ding; mite, sate, ganhingte tunga leng vasa te tannin; ka bawl jiakin ka kisik ahi, a chi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground; man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky; for I am sorry that I have made them.”

paite: Noain bel Toupa hehpihna a mu hi.
english: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.

paite: Noa suan hiaite ahi uh. Noa midik ahia, a dam tonpihte lakah gensiatbei ahi: Noa Pathian toh a om khawm uh.
english: This is the history of the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

paite: Huan Noain tapa thum Sem, Ham, leh Japheth a nei.
english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

paite: Huan, Pathian mitmuhin lei a se khintaa, lei hiamgam nain a dim khinta hi.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

paite: Huan, Pathianin lei a en a, huan ngaiin, a se khinta; sa tengtengin lah leitungah a omdan uh a hihse khinta ngal ua.
english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

paite: Huan, Pathianin Noa kiangah, sa tengteng beina ka maah a hongtungta; amaute jiakin lei hiamgam nain a dim khinta ngala; huchiin, ngaiin a lei nasanin ka hihmang ding.
english: God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

paite: Nang dingin meilah singin long bawlin; longah dantante na bawl ding ahi. A sunglam leh a pawlam meilah naiin na jut vek ding ahi.
english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

paite: Huan, hiai na bawl dingdan ahi: Long dung lam tong za thum hi henla, a vailam tong sawm nga hi henla, asanlam tong sawm thum hi hen.
english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship will be three hundred cubits, its breadth fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

paite: Longah tohlet na bawl dinga, a tunglam tong khat chianga na zoh ding ahi; huan, long kongkhak a pangah na bawl ding a; chial nuainung leh chial nihna leh chial thumna nei in na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

paite: Huan, Ngaiin, kei mahmahin, sa tengteng, hinna hatna pai khempeuh, van nuaia kipan hih mangthang dingin, leitungah tuichim ka tungsak ding hi; leia thil chih om a si ve ding uh.
english: I, even I, do bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.

paite: Ahihhangin ka thukhun na tungah kakipsak zo dinga, longah na lut ding ahi; nang na lut ding ahia, na tapate leh na ji leh, na tapate jite leng na kiangah a lut sam ding uh ahi.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

paite: Huan, sa tengtenga thilhing chiteng laka pat, chichih nihnihin, na kiangah hinsak dingin longah na pi lut ding ahi: a nu leh a pa jel a hih ding uhi.
english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

paite: Vasate amau chi omdan bang chiatin, gante amau chi omdan bang chiatin, chi chih nin nihin, na hinsak dingin, na kiangah a hongpai ding uh ahi.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort shall come to you, to keep them alive.

paite: Huan, na annek tengteng uh la inla, na kiangah koih khawm in; huchiin, nang leh amau adin an ahi ding uh, a chi hi.Huchibangin Noain a hih a; Pathianin a kianga thu a piak tengteng bangin a hihta hi.
english: Take with you of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

paite: Huchibangin Noain a hih a; Pathianin a kianga thu a piak tengteng bangin a hihta hi.
english: Thus Noah did. According to all that God commanded him, so he did.
